column2: Led by $$マルコ$$, leader of the underground organization, the party...
at last succeeded in locating the $$アンゲルス教$$ $$総本山$$,
said to lie in the $$悪魔の海峡$$.
Yet during the journey,
at $$マルコ$$'s rather forceful urging,
they headed for a city hemmed in by towering, precipitous mountains:
a remote city beyond even the $$異端審問官$$s' reach,
$$ソドムとゴモラ$$.
According to $$マルコ$$, these two cities...
were built by some black $$羽$$ people critical of the $$奴隷$$ system,
along with white $$羽$$ people,
as one of their great military bases, also called the $$背徳の都$$.
It openly proclaims supposedly $$大罪$$—$$平等$$ and $$人権$$—as its founding ideals,
and strives to build a city regardless of $$羽$$ color...
A utopia for white $$羽$$ people, they say.
But what awaited them there was...
a conflict between two sides so $$平等$$ that none could predict it—
a battle between two $$正義$$s!!
